This report will detail construction commencement and work awarding for sixteen NBCC-managed projects. Homebuyers had complained about significant delays beyond previously established timelines. The tribunal also directed the committee to address unpaid employee salaries for three months. The next hearing for this matter is scheduled for September 14, 2026.

banking-economy.title: IDFC First Bank 'scam': CBI files chargesheet against 6 Haryana IAS officers, 13 others
banking-economy.summary: The CBI filed a chargesheet against nineteen accused in a Rs 504-crore fund misappropriation case. Six Haryana cadre IAS officers and bank officials were named in the chargesheet. The accused allegedly orchestrated a fraudulent scheme to misappropriate government funds. These funds were transferred to specific bank branches and then to third parties. The CBI has now charged a total of thirty-seven individuals in this ongoing investigation.

banking-economy.title: L&T Finance plans to add 500 gold loan branches annually
banking-economy.summary: L&T Finance plans to add 500 gold loan branches annually for five years. This expansion aims to reach a network of 2,500 to 3,000 branches nationwide. The company expects its gold finance book to grow over fifty percent annually. This growth is driven by increasing branch footprint and market opportunities. India's gold loan market has significant untapped potential for organized lenders.
